description: Sign and explain crabcrop image URLs, fetch processed-image metadata, and purge cached results.
name: io.github.crabcrop/crabcrop

environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the crabcrop server the tools act on (for example https://images.example.com).
environmentVariables.name: CRABCROP_BASE

environmentVariables.description: The server's signing secret, used by sign_url and purge_result. Keep it in the environment, not in tool arguments.
environmentVariables.name: CRABCROP_SECRET
